title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease: Amount of an End-of-Term Hold Payment
content:
**Lease-end billing clause — the hold payment amount, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Clause.** The hold payment is the hold rate of 50 percent times the invoiced end-of-term balance, rounded to the nearest cent with a half cent rounded up (0.0001 cent is added before rounding so that an amount lying exactly on a half cent rounds up).

**The invoiced end-of-term balance.** The invoiced end-of-term balance is the end-of-term charges billed on the day the end-of-term invoice was mailed, less every end-of-term charge waiver, security deposit application and end-of-term payment posted on the lease, a waiver of a term fee such as a late charge not being taken off; a charge billed on any other day is not part of it. Where the lease has more than one end-of-term invoice, the latest mailing date is read.

**Leases the amount is figured for.** The lease's end-of-term invoice falls due on its mailing date plus the end-of-term payment period of 30 calendar days. A hold payment is figured for a lease whose due date passed more than 30 days earlier (the hold-start day count), the days since the due date being counted from the day after the due date through today, and on which no end-of-term payment has posted since the invoice was mailed. Once a hold payment posts, the balance left is not charged off until 60 calendar days after the hold payment posts (the hold period).

| Invoice mailed (hypothetical) | Due date | Today | Days since the due date | Within the hold-start day count |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| March 1 | March 31 | April 30 | 30 | no — not more than 30 |
| March 1 | March 31 | May 1 | 31 | yes |

**Worked example (all inputs hypothetical)**

On the day the end-of-term invoice was mailed, the lease was billed a disposition fee of $395.00 and an excess wear charge of $1450.00. A wear forgiveness waiver of $250.00 on the excess wear charge and a security deposit application of $500.00 have posted; a $25.00 late charge from the lease term was waived as a courtesy; an excess mileage charge of $310.00 was billed eleven days later.

- Invoiced end-of-term balance: $395.00 plus $1450.00, less $250.00, less $500.00, that is $1095.00. The excess mileage charge, billed on another day, is not part of it, and the courtesy waiver of the late charge, a term-fee waiver, is not taken off.
- Hold payment: 50 percent of $1095.00, that is $547.50.
